question: For administratively up ports in tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, return each port’s ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of standard attribute ID (partitioned by VIF type); also include, per VIF type, the total port count, the overall average port count benchmark and the HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER category, and for the same port status show the variance of standard attribute ID, the number of distinct ports, and the deviation of that variance from the overall average variance among ports with IP allocation `10.150.64.113/8`. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VIF type as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id, b.host, b.vif_type, b.vnic_type, p.tenant_id, p.network_id,
         p.mac_address, p.status, p.device_owner, p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' AND p.admin_state_up = 1
),
w AS (
  SELECT base.*,
         AVG(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY vif_type ORDER BY standard_attr_id
                                     ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS win_avg
  FROM base
),
vif_counts AS (
  SELECT vif_type, COUNT(id) AS total_port_count FROM base GROUP BY vif_type
),
vif_stats AS (
  SELECT vc.vif_type, vc.total_port_count,
         AVG(vc.total_port_count) OVER () AS overall_avg_port_count,
         CASE WHEN vc.total_port_count >= 1.5 * AVG(vc.total_port_count) OVER () THEN 'HIGH_USER'
              WHEN vc.total_port_count <= 0.5 * AVG(vc.total_port_count) OVER () THEN 'LOW_USER'

status_stats AS (
